title: Anxious People
author: Fredrik Backman
summary: A desperate would-be bank robber flees into an apartment viewing and ends up holding a group of strangers hostage. As the police ask questions, each person's private worries come out.
readIf: you want a comic ensemble story that is secretly about loneliness, parenthood and being kind to strangers.
skipIf: you dislike narrators who wander off on tangents or want a tight, strictly plotted mystery.

pairings.reason: The author's best-known novel, with the same mix of dry jokes and sudden emotional weight.
Another warm, funny ensemble of mismatched people thrown together around a crime.
Also reveals a tightly knit community's secrets through an incident, with a sharper, more satirical edge.
